description:
Wrap a Wasm module already owned by the calling worker. Use open for initialization.
module: Emscripten module instance.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint

description:
Await an exported mutation, including storage completion; native errors reject.
name: Export name.
types: Emscripten argument types.
args: Argument values.
Returns: Nonnegative native status.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#call

description:
Run the C++ command parser after copying a UTF-8 input line.
line: At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes without NUL.
now: Trusted server time in seconds.
Returns: Copied output and quit/error/sync flags; the worker handles transport.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#console

description:
Generate and copy one pending frame, awaiting nonce reservation before success.
Returns: Owned bytes, or null when idle. Never delivers the frame.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#outbound

description:
Copy bytes into the shared 4096-byte bridge input; callers serialize access.
bytes: Input bytes.
offset: Byte offset.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#put

description:
Authenticate a complete frame and await durable state updates.
frame: Between 1 and 512 bytes.
now: Trusted server time in seconds.
Returns: Completion; failures reject.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#receive

description:
Apply a fleet control to this server, persisting pending work without delivery.
command: begin, cancel, approve, issue, or request.
args: Challenge/key for approval or decimal total for issuance.
now: Trusted server time in seconds; enrollment lasts 600 seconds.
Returns: ok on success; errors reject.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#server

description:
Copy public diagnostics; uint64 values remain decimal strings.
Returns: Public state or null when unavailable.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#state

description:
Write exact uint64 slots at input offset 2048; avoids Asyncify i64 argument rewind.
values: At most two values in the uint64 range.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint#values

description:
Create an isolated instance and await initialization from durable storage. Missing or incompatible saved state rejects.
factory: Emscripten module factory.
storage: Awaitable load/save callbacks.
role: Device or server role.
serial: Validated serial.
pin: Hexadecimal 32-byte server public key.
fresh: Require a new identity.
Returns: Initialized, exclusively owned endpoint.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.Endpoint.open

description:
Parse an exact unsigned decimal uint64 without converting through Number.
text: Decimal digits only.
Returns: The exact value; malformed or overflowing input throws.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.uint64

description:
Validate a serial before creating storage or identity state.
serial: Between 1 and 32 printable non-space ASCII bytes.
Returns: The validated serial; invalid input throws.
name: module:examples/common/endpoint.validSerial

description:
Delete all fleet and endpoint records in one durable transaction.
db: Open database; caller must stop endpoint instances first.
Returns: Completion; aborts reject without reporting success.
name: module:examples/common/storage.clearFleet

description:
Create callbacks for one endpoint namespace. Persist encoded records and nonce high-water marks, never raw native context memory.
db: Open database.
serial: Validated device serial.
role: Device or server namespace.
fresh: Whether initialization requires an absent endpoint record.
Returns: Asynchronous read/write callbacks used by the Wasm provider.
name: module:examples/common/storage.endpointStorage

description:
Open the versioned browser database; incompatible or failed stores reject instead of replacing identities. The owning worker holds the fleet Web Lock.
Returns: Open database connection.
name: module:examples/common/storage.openDatabase

description:
Run one object-store operation and resolve only after transaction completion.
db: Open database.
store: Object store name.
mode: Access mode.
operation: Callback returning an IDBRequest.
Returns: Request result after durable completion; aborts reject.
name: module:examples/common/storage.transaction

description:
Deliver pending opaque frames between connected simulated endpoints until idle or awaiting enrollment approval.
server: Server endpoint.
device: Running device endpoint, or null when stopped.
now: Trusted server time for enrollment expiry.
log: Observer for completed transfer messages.
Returns: Completion; rejected frames or nonconvergence throw.

description:
Wrap one isolated guided-demo Wasm instance.
module: Emscripten module with scw exports.

args: Command-specific inputs; uint64 values must be exact.
Returns: Native status, copied state and optional frame; malformed inputs reject.

Copy input bytes into the instance-owned bridge buffer.
bytes: Input bytes.
offset: Offset within the 4096-byte buffer.

description:
Copy public diagnostics; this is not a restorable native context.
Returns: Public state with exact decimal counters.
name: module:web/endpoint.Endpoint#state

description:
Decode exactly one 32-byte public key from hexadecimal.
text: A 64-character hexadecimal key.
Returns: Fresh key bytes; malformed input throws.
name: module:web/endpoint.unhex

Approve the displayed candidate binding at the current simulated time.

Execute a worker command and update visible state and events.

command: Bridge command.
args: Command arguments.

id: Packet identifier.

Discard a packet without reception and record the outcome.

Queue a second copy without mutating the original.
id: Packet identifier.
name: module:web/lab.Lab#duplicate

kind: Event category.

Generate a fresh device identity after optional challenge verification.

Move a visible packet between transport locations.
id: Packet identifier.

Find a queued packet or throw if it is no longer available.

Initialize the generated device with its serial and pinned server key.

Send a command to one worker and correlate its response; no peer transfer occurs.
role: Endpoint role.
command: Bridge command.
args: Command arguments.

Archive a packet with its final outcome, keeping bounded history.

Queue a copy of archived bytes for explicit replay testing.
